highlights: Direct recruitment, training, coordination, evaluation, and spiritual development of catechists to teach and assist with Religious Education programs, Vacation Bible School, and Sacramental preparation for Reconciliation, First Communion, and Confirmation
Define responsibilities and serve as advisor and support to each catechist
Coordinate schedules and oversee content, resources, and programming for Religious Education including preparing for First Communion, Reconciliation and Confirmation
Coordinate both First Communion and Confirmation retreats
Coordinate parent nights for religious education parents
Coordinate Sacramental preparation: RCIA, RCIC, FOCCUS
Devise yearly curriculum and calendars for programs
Coordinate special liturgies, activities and events for Christmas
Recruit, train, and schedule altar servers
Organize and coordinate youth mass
Collaborate with parish staff and committees to plan and coordinate family social events
Collaborate with the Communication Director to develop and maintain effective means for publicizing and promoting programs
Collaborate with parish finance committee to secure funding for programs and ensure expenses remain within budget
Serve as liaison with parish families, parish community, and the Archdiocese of Milwaukee
Initiate procedures for evaluating all aspects of parish's ministry to youth
Maintain necessary office and program records
Keep parish staff and faith community informed of child/family ministry programs, activities, goals, and experiences
Attend parish meetings as warranted
Stay informed of developments directed toward improving child/family ministry through attending diocesan, regional, and national conferences
Lead and manage other projects as assigned
